name: Wardrobe 1100 (zhitov drawing)
comment: From the zhitov.com drawing: 1100 x 600 x 2460, 18 mm board, in U156 ST9 Pjescano bez. Built the flatpack way: six 100 mm adjustable legs under a full-width bottom panel at z 100, sides (2324) standing on it, top over the sides, the 3 mm HDF back nailed over the rear faces of sides, top and bottom (boards 597 deep, 600 overall), plinth clipped to the front legs (its back face on the leg line, y 50, so it is recessed 68 behind the door face). Interior 2324 as on the drawing. Fixed shelf 400 under the top; below it a partition (1906) runs down to the bottom panel and splits the interior into two 523 columns, each with a shelf about 316 over the bottom (the drawing labels read 512 but 523 + 18 + 523 = 1064, the inner width it also gives). All six column shelves are adjustable, on 5 mm pins (18 long, 9 in the board) in 32 mm rows of holes drawn as dots (y 50 and 550): full rows z 173.5..1965.5 in the right column, and in the hanging column just five positions around the bottom shelf, z 365.5..493.5. Bottom shelves at 432 in both columns; the right column shelf at 1072 (partition mid-height) is full depth (594) and fixed with confirmats through the side and the partition, with the back stapled to it, to stiffen the column, with no hole positions within 64 of it; the other right column shelves at 784 / 1072 / 1392 / 1712 (compartments 332, 270, 302, 302, 294: the lowest one sits a grid step higher than the drawing's 300 so it clears the second door hinge at z 741). Column shelves are 570 deep, set back 27 from the carcass front (the top shelf stays full depth). Left column: hanging rail. Top filler (65) flush with the door face, backed by a 55 x 18 strip lying flat on the carcass top, screwed down through it into the top 27 from the front edge on the bench; the filler is scribed on site and then glued and doweled to the backer front edge, since nothing fits behind it under the ceiling, running the full 1100 width, as on wardrobe-hall: total height 2525 to the ceiling. The exposed right side is covered by a full-height end panel (2525 x 618) flush with the door face, scribed on site to floor and ceiling; overall width 1118. Doors are not on the drawing; two hinged doors assumed, 545 and 543 (the right one 2 narrower for a 5 mm gap to the end panel). Fasteners are modelled as hardware parts (not cut): confirmat 7x50 at every fixed carcass joint (caps 2 mm proud where visible, flush against the wall and behind the end panel), 4x30 wood screws for the end panel and the filler backer, 8x30 dowels for the filler, 5 mm shelf pins for the four adjustable shelves, rail holders, plinth clips on the front legs, staples for the HDF back. Hinges (cup, arm, plate) and handles are drawn by the viewer.
